title: AIPointer: Hold a key, ask a question, get an answer about whatever your cursor is pointing at
description:
Google's Magic Pointer is Chromebook-only. AIPointer brings it to every OS. Wiggle your mouse or hit a hotkey and a glassmorphism overlay appears right next to your cursor. It screenshots whatever you're pointing at and feeds it to a vision model. Type or speak your question in any of seven languages, get your answer without switching tabs or copying anything. Bring your own key, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/gonemedia/aipointer
